title: Doxology (Mid-Six Psalms)
content:
Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit, now and for ever and ever. Amen.
Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia! Glory be to You, O God! (3x)
Lord, have mercy (3x).
Glory to the Father and to the Son and to the Holy Spirit, now and for ever and ever. Amen.
